primitives.name: Interview Intrusion Deterrence
primitives.verbatim_quote: For instance, very naturally, as the game draws near, everybody who knows any member of the team or coaching staff becomes possessed of an overpowering desire to interview him.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes rational utility maximization by interviewers seeking social proof, zero transaction costs for intrusion, and independent player performance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs when interview frequency exceeds player cognitive capacity, causing performance degradation.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI Conformal Inference via sequential hypothesis testing: P(intrusion | performance) < threshold triggers recalibration of win probability intervals.
layer2.telemetry: Number of pre-game interviews per player divided by average attention span (seconds).
